WHERE: Frontmatter, Tasks, Review Log
EVIDENCE: docs/specs/add.md:2 declares in-progress and line 45 marks implementation complete, but the Review Log at lines 51-54 contains no review or owner acceptance. The pinned feature-document standard requires a clean independent spec review and recorded owner acceptance before implementation.
PROPOSAL: Return the document to draft and complete the review and owner acceptance steps before re-entering in-progress.

FINDING: F-02
KIND: factual
SEVERITY: should-fix
WHERE: Owner summary, Acceptance Criteria, Test Plan
EVIDENCE: The goal and Design promise addition of two numbers, but AC-01 and math.test.ts:3 check only add(2, 3). I ran bun test and observed one passing assertion. An implementation returning the constant 5 would satisfy the entire criterion and test while violating the stated behavior.
PROPOSAL: Expand the criterion and proof to establish addition across differing inputs, including zero, negative values and fractions. Limit the owner summary's proof claim to what those checks establish.
